title: RepoMesh Repository Review Decision v1
description: Request body of POST /api/v1/agent-actions/leader/assignments/{taskId}/review. The leader's evidence-based verdict over the review_due assignment package. Invariants the server enforces (409 review_invalid_findings on violation, pinned by contract tests): verdict request_rework requires at least one finding carrying reworkInstruction; every finding's workerTaskId must appear in the review evidence. approve makes the leader task SUCCEEDED with summary as the roll-up body; request_rework creates new revision worker tasks through the formal assignment path without touching already-terminal ones; escalate makes the leader task BLOCKED and triggers the existing EXCEPTION_ESCALATION checkpoint.

summary.description: For approve, this becomes the leader task's roll-up summary toward the Organization Manager.

reworkInstruction.description: Present on findings that demand rework; each becomes a new revision worker task.

findings.description: May be empty for approve; must contain at least one reworkInstruction-bearing entry for request_rework.
